opening.argument: The title identifies Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan’s call on President Mukherjee, and the footage shows the officials greeting one another and meeting in a formal setting. The description places the visit at Rashtrapati Bhavan and describes it as reflecting warm India-UAE relations and intensifying cooperation. Those details establish a governmental, news-style purpose, not a request for money, credentials, or financial participation. The description also mentions UAE business participation in Indian development programs, but as part of the reported discussion, not as a solicitation to viewers. Follow and subscribe requests are ordinary audience engagement. The material is therefore consistent with general news, lifestyle and entertainment, rather than a scam.

citations.quote: Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi called on President Mukherjee

The President of India, Shri Pranab Mukherjee yesterday (January 25, 2017) receivedHis Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Deputy Supreme Commander of UAE Armed Forcesat Rashtrapati Bhavan.
the President said this State visit is a reflection of the warm relations and intensifying co-operation between India and the UAE.
